question: Can dated common means and three learned joint uncertainty laws retain minute skill and honest final-law calibration, then improve player points without team harm?
status: frozen before new fits/draws/outcomes; C04 outcomes previously exposed
basis: C01 realised-minute headroom is a priority signal, not proof of predictability. C03 altered/capped learner packages leave attribution unresolved. Challenge the pre-game joint role/minute architecture, keep possession heads fixed.
population: known B1 200 actual-participant games, all remain development; no operational availability claim; first2 wiring, first20 shortlist, fixed200 finalist

history.sources: NBA canonical regular-season on_court seasons2023..2026 excluding Cup finals; existing pinned source guards and C01 accepted games
history.evaluated_feature_updates: source history before each origin, through latest known panel origin, seasons2023..2026 only; other earlier historical games may update lag features but are never scored as fresh tests; same-day outcomes excluded
history.fits: Shared ridge lambda100, closed form using all common features/history; fit origins2024-06-30,2025-06-30,2025-11-30. Residuals July2024-June2025 use first; July-Nov2025 second; December third. One recipe each; no search or convergence cap. C mixture weight learned only on December with earlier residual library, then final libraries include December.

features.origin: current roster membership conditional on actual participants is common to all arms; all minute/starter values and team assignments used as features strictly earlier than origin; current starter/pos/target forbidden
features.missing: first-game minutes10,spread6,start0,days365,history0; explicit n_history; fixed before scores
features.team_representation: C sees all same features through12 equally spaced prior-alloc rank positions plus roster_n; training-only standardisation; A/B receive own and roster summaries; no player IDs

A.name: whole-team chronological empirical residual law
A.recipe: Same ridge means for ABC. Sample one whole-team residual(reg-legal mean), prior-alloc rank aligned, rank interpolate to roster size, bounded Euclidean240 projection; quantise to balanced seconds. All historical team residuals, no arbitrary spread.

B.name: learned bounded latent logistic joint law
B.recipe: Clip actual and legal mean minutes to[.25,47.75] ONLY for logit coordinates; canonical12 rank-interpolated logit residual vectors. Learn full12x12 mean/covariance, unbiased covariance, eigendecompose with only negative numerical eigenvalues set0. Gaussian latent draw, rank map, add logit means then solve additive logistic offset for bounded240 minutes directly; balanced-second quantisation. Source truth/scoring stays unchanged.

C.name: learned whole-team mixture of A and dated legacy-family law
C.recipe: Whole-team mixture. Legacy-family independent normal residuals around same ridge means, player residual SD estimated by dated alloc bands0,4,..48 using same chronological residual population; no arbitrary floor/inflation, missing bands use pooledSD. Both laws bounded240 and quantised. Learn one mixture weight by minimising summed proper CRPS on all December team-games,1000 draws/component, analytic convex quadratic in weight with endpoint clipping[0,1]; fixed seeds. Final all-family libraries include December. Weight is learned parameter, not additional candidate slate.

library_deliverable: Three fitted runnable uncertainty laws, exact-time legal schedule decoder, common minute/player/team proper scoring, independent fit/draw/world reproduction. Supporting engineering alone is not major product progress.
causal_tests: future or same-day history injection cannot change origin features
invalid minute vectors and fewer-than5 rosters refused

minute_screen.baseline: first1000 native pinned incumbent regulation-minute draws; compare same player keys and unscaled reconstructed regulation truth
minute_screen.primary: After legal law/quantisation: CRPS >=2% lower than native, both halves improve, game/week Bonferroni3 upper<0;>=100games/2000player rows
minute_screen.critical: usage>=.25 minuteCRPS point harm<=2%; overall coverage80 in[.76,.84], coverage50 in[.45,.55], coverage95 in[.92,.98]; critical coverage80 in[.73,.87]; equal-game/source-quality/roster-size sensitivities reported
minute_screen.shortlist: at most2 passing families ranked CRPS; no replacement or altered rules after outcomes
minute_screen.training_credibility: report heldout Oct-Nov improvement vs240/roster_n, convergence/budget-bound status and fit coverage. No arbitrary sample cap. Failed convergence/support cannot establish architectural ceiling.

integration.decoder: Exact second-resolution McNaughton five-lane wrap scheduling, no self-overlap since targets<=48; balanced largest-remainder quantisation<1second/player,exact14400seconds. Original forecasted timing centres determine ordering; FFT circular phase maximises on-time overlap as preference. No claim of realistic substitution timing. Both native bridge and challengers use same decoder; generated fouls/OT remain engine-driven, final returned minutes separately scored.
integration.bridge_control: native incumbent per-world regulation-minute draws passed through identical new schedule decoder; required to expose schedule-translation effects
integration.native_control: reuse pinned original C01 captures on all200; no regenerated unchanged control ritual; simulation seed c02-possession-v1 for all new arms, same fixed event/conversion/foul/clocks, original source profiles
integration.wiring: all mechanically valid families and bridge control first2 x1000 even if minute screen fails, to deliver runnable models; native control retained
integration.cheap_game_panel: only up to2 minute-screen survivors continue to first20 x1000; first2 reused; no advancement by minute score alone
integration.finalist_panel: only practical complete-game survivors expand to fixed200 x1000; no score-driven extension; maximum2
integration.projection: Euclidean bounded simplex:0<=regminutes<=48,sum240; legal time constraint, never a scoring/shot/point quota; no full-game count targets

game_shortlist.benefit: player PTS CRPS >=.5% lower vs BOTH native and bridge, both500-world halves lower
game_shortlist.runtime: candidate median generation/bridge ratio<=2; finite exact common scores/support; no next-event learner changes

final_acceptance: known200 research gain only: playerPTS >=1% better vs BOTH references, both simulation halves improve, whole-game/week Bonferroni6 upper<0; harm confidence upper below same practical limits for both references; critical contexts>=30games/200player rows, >=100games overall; coverage80 deterioration confidence bound<=.03. No automatic production promotion.
uncertainty: 10000 seed20261125 paired whole-game and fixed ordinal//7 week-block bootstraps; pooled and equal-game;95% descriptive and Bonferroni3 minute/6 dual-reference game intervals. Full slate/exposure counts, no reset after selection.

budget.data: one full chronological lag pass, source-guarded; same full supported history for all
budget.fits: 3 shared chronological closed-form mean fits; ABC residual/moment libraries and one learned mixture parameter; one fresh full repeat. No extra trials.
budget.worlds: 606000 maximum new event worlds including wiring and repeat; all200 x1000 minute draws per family, native controls reused; four first-game repeat arms included. Training uncertainty draws are not event worlds.
budget.threads: ten total heavy; fits10 then workers10x1; BLAS/Arrow1; source I/O may overlap within cap; pool shutdown before parent work
budget.technical_faults: Preserve logs/partial namespaces; only demonstrable implementation repairs with unchanged recipes/criteria/budget. Source/data/code hashes gate resume. No posthoc candidate or tuning.

decision_limits: If minute predictions fail, conclude these recipes do not establish recoverable minute skill. If minutes improve but game forecasts do not, diagnose translation/joint effects and do not claim product gain. Native/bridge disagreements remain visible. Negative work must eliminate a stated explanation or isolate the remaining confound; no model-class impossibility claim.
